summary: Fresh independent Chinese source-date audit after the c9b5630b88f9 post-curation extraction. All 290 source units, 54 temporal or active-hint items, and 18 people were checked. The curation correctly converts eight borrowed or reign-wide personal dates into research holds, but those holds preclude approval. Independently, Güshi Khan's seizure follows 崇德七年 only as 未幾, so its AD 1642 point claims and active hint require one-sided or unresolved repair. No extraction data was changed by this audit.
